claims.claim_text: The paper presents Dr. RTL, a multi-agent framework that automates critical-path analysis, RTL rewriting, and implementation-level evaluation, and keeps improving through reusable optimization skills.
claims.excerpt: We present Dr. RTL, a multi-agent framework that automates critical-path analysis, RTL rewriting, and implementation-level evaluation, while continuously improving through reusable optimization skills.

claims.claim_text: The authors say Dr. RTL achieved average WNS/TNS improvements of 21%/17% with a 6% area reduction over commercial synthesis on 20 real-world RTL designs.
claims.excerpt: Evaluated on 20 real-world RTL designs, Dr.~RTL achieves average WNS/TNS improvements of 21\%/17\% with a 6\% area reduction over commercial synthesis.

claims.claim_text: The paper discusses reference-based and open-ended RTL optimization benchmarks that evaluate optimization opportunities under realistic EDA workflows.
claims.excerpt: We discuss reference-based and open-ended RTL optimization benchmarks that evaluate optimization opportunities under realistic EDA workflows.

claims.claim_text: The authors explore agent-driven synthesis script tuning and the discovery of executable synthesis algorithms across intermediate representations, technology-independent optimization, and technology mapping.
claims.excerpt: We explore agent-driven synthesis script tuning and the discovery of executable synthesis algorithms across intermediate representations, technology-independent optimization, and technology mapping.

claims.claim_text: The authors envision AI-native design automation that jointly explores architectural, RTL, and EDA algorithm design spaces, guided by verification constraints and implementation feedback.
claims.excerpt: Finally, we envision AI-native design automation that jointly explores architectural, RTL, and EDA algorithm design spaces, guided by verification constraints and implementation feedback.

claims.claim_text: The paper is an ASP-DAC'27 invited paper submitted to arXiv on 10 Nov 2026.
